xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA band"><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA ring outer"></e-div-block><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA ring inner"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA content"><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA label"><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="CTA eyebrow"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA rule 2"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-heading configuration-id="CTA title"></e-heading><e-paragraph configuration-id="CTA text"></e-paragraph><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA buttons"><e-button configuration-id="CTA quote"></e-button><e-button configuration-id="CTA call"></e-button></e-flexbox></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

CTA title.title: Not sure which brand suits your concept?

CTA text.paragraph: Share your venue type, covers and style — our team will recommend the right brands and build a tailored product selection for you.

style.CTA band: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; min-height: 560px; padding: 107px 100px 80px 100px; overflow: hidden; gap: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7,31,68,0.84) 0%, rgba(7,31,68,0.84) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/brands-cta-bg.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; @media(--tablet){ min-height: 0px; padding: 96px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ min-height: 0px; padding: 72px 20px; }
style.CTA ring outer: position: absolute; padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; left: calc(50% - 380px); top: -100px; width: 760px; height: 760px; border-width: 1.2px; border-color: rgba(222,175,87,0.3);
style.CTA ring inner: position: absolute; padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; left: calc(50% - 280px); top: 0px; width: 560px; height: 560px; border-width: 1px; border-color: rgba(222,175,87,0.18);
style.CTA content: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 26px; padding: 0px; width: 900px; max-width: 100%; position: relative; z-index: 1;
style.CTA title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 68px; line-height: 70px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; text-align: center; max-width: 860px; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 52px; line-height: 56px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 38px; line-height: 42px; }
style.CTA text: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 17px; line-height: 29px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-align: center; max-width: 640px; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CTA buttons: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; width: 100%; }
